_doc: Footswitch positions per pedal catalog id. Written ONLY by scripts/pedal_editor.py. x,y are fractions (0..1) of the Pedal Playground image, origin top-left, in the UNROTATED pedal, at the CENTRE of the switch cap. type: bypass (turns the pedal, or one side of it, on/off) | tap (tap tempo) | boost (a boost / extra-gain stomp) | function (any other switch: octave, clipping, preset...). Optional diameter_mm (null if unknown). [] = checked: the pedal has no footswitch. A missing id = unknown. No image is stored.
